name: 05_severity_escalation
description: A medium-severity signal starts out merely queued. A second, more severe signal correlates in on the same resource and escalates the whole incident's severity to the worst signal seen (per app/correlation.py's _more_severe) - not just its score. Good for showing that escalation is a distinct mechanic from correlated_count alone (contrast with scenario 4, where severity never changes).
expected_outcome: signal 1 alone: 15 (medium) + 10 (1 type) + 18 (kubernetes) + 0 (0.6GB upload below 1GB anomaly floor) = 43 -> queued. After signal 2 correlates (severity escalates medium -> critical, 2 types, best source azure_monitor, public-read bucket anomaly): 40 + 25 + 20 + 10 = 95 -> investigating.
